responsibility: Provides reusable builders for type-checking diagnostics whose messages need structured, context-sensitive reporting and suggestions. This module groups the logic for emitting E0617 when variadic-call arguments require an explicit cast, E0607 when an invalid cast attempts to convert a thin pointer to a fat pointer, and E0107 when a path supplies the wrong number or kind of generic arguments, so these files collectively centralize specialized error construction for common type-system mistakes.
